settingsCalculatorAutoDesc: Update the amount when unit price or quantity changes
settingsHideAmountsDesc: Notifications show only a generic message
settingsAiEnabledDesc: Answers questions using calculations done on this device
settingsAiConsent: Allow sharing summaries with online AI
settingsAiConsentDesc: Only totals needed to answer your question are sent. Raw transactions, notes and attachments are never sent.
aiPrivacyExplanation: All amounts are calculated by HisabMitra on your phone. With the on-device engine nothing leaves your phone. If you enable online AI and give consent, only the summary figures for your question (for example 'expenses this month by category') are sent to the provider to phrase the answer. The AI can never add, change or delete your records.
settingsLogoutConfirm: Log out? Your hisab stays saved in your account and is removed from this phone. Categories and settings stay on the phone.
settingsDeleteAccountDesc: Deletes your account, its saved hisab and bills, and your group memberships.
signOutUnsentBody: {count} changes haven't been saved to your account yet. Logging out now loses them.
